It performed redundant actions by clicking on each gym listing individually on the same search results page to verify its type (steps 13, 17, 21, 25, 29), when much of this information (e.g., 'Gym', 'Martial arts club') was already visible or easily extractable from the initial search results in step 9. More critically, the system failed to filter out gyms that were not in West Virginia, as explicitly requested in the query. 'Crunch Fitness - Mount Pleasant' and 'Cage Fitness' were located in Mount Pleasant, SC (South Carolina), not West Virginia, as clearly indicated in the detailed views (e.g., step 25 for Crunch Fitness). This led to unnecessary verification steps for irrelevant results, demonstrating a lack of directness and inefficient resource usage.
